# VideoLAN components

- LibVLC native engine and plug-ins come from the `VideoLAN.LibVLC.Windows` 3.0.24 package. [VLC 3.0.24 source and checksums](https://get.videolan.org/vlc/3.0.24/).
- The Windows UI binding comes from the `LibVLCSharp.WinUI` 3.10.0 package. [Source revision identified in the package metadata](https://code.videolan.org/videolan/LibVLCSharp/-/tree/59d70e96026229e7c232ce5074ecefbf6f8959b6).
- Both NuGet packages identify the license as LGPL-2.1-or-later. `COPYING.LIB` and `COPYING` are the license texts distributed in the VLC 3.0.24 source tree. Individual VLC modules may carry separate notices.
